# Prompt
Classify each target as1 if its measured dsDNA-binding score is at least3, and0 otherwise. This is a benchmark operational threshold on the source assay scale, not a clinical safety cutoff. Return a single JSON object mapping every target name to0or1.

All molecules are the VHH-Fc constructs listed in Table9; sequence1 contains the complete tested fusion chain. Molecular names have been anonymized. The row reference is a measured reference and is not a target. All eight other rows must be predicted. The source dsDNA ELISA coats1ug/mL dsDNA overnight at4C, blocks withPBS+0.5%BSA, applies100nM VHH-Fc atroom temperature for1h, detects anti-humanIgG-HRP and reads450nm. Score is normalized absorbance relative to no-antibody control wells; higher scores indicate stronger nonspecific DNA binding. 

Use only the supplied CSV. Do not browse, execute code or call external tools. Return only the JSON object; include every target once and no explanations.
